name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Pendleton IN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (2025-06) shows a chain-link perimeter fence with slatted privacy panels and a wide sliding/swing gate opening across the truck drive at the NE entrance off Enterprise Dr; concrete jersey barriers channel traffic into the lanes.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the entrance in any Street View heading; entry control is fence + gate + barriers only.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but unmanned (no shack) implies kiosk / call-box / app check-in.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Curved paved apron on Enterprise Dr immediately outside the gate gives room for arriving trucks to wait.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard inside the gate before docks for queueing/maneuvering.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and ample paved entry width; room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single combined gate lane controlled by jersey barriers; in/out share the one opening (estimate).
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Shared with entry through the same gate (estimate).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks run along the west, south, and east building faces with trailers backed in across all three; total well into the 50+ band (estimated ~180 doors).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated drop yard with fishbone/angled trailer rows on the east side plus a large south trailer yard; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks split across separate building faces (west long bank vs south/east banks) consistent with separate shipping/receiving clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot full of parked trailers separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Pendleton IN: bordered by I-69 and farm fields with some adjacent apartment/industrial development; broader setting is rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimated from visible drop-yard rows and open paved yard; approximate.

citations.claim: TSC corporate careers posting for a DC HR Intern at the Pendleton, IN 46064 distribution center, Summer 2026 - proves an actively staffed, currently operating TSC-run DC at this site.
Listed as Tractor Supply Distribution Center 114, Pendleton IN - corroborates DC #114 identity.

verification.rationale: TSC corporate careers shows an active 2026 DC role at this exact address (DC #114); no closure/WARN; truck-yard DC, not a store.
